CustomObject.description: Configures mock response scenarios for API services. Supports dynamic response interpolation, request body pattern matching, and fault simulation for both inbound and outbound APIs. A record answers only while mocking is on for its service: in the API Test Harness or a test, under Mock All APIs or Mock All Inbound APIs, or when the service's API Setting has Mocking Enabled ticked and Mock Selected APIs is on for the user.
CustomObject.label: API Mock
